note: STARTER SET proposed for the project. Check topics, competencies and weights against the official JAMB syllabus and edit freely. exam_weight is a placeholder (1.0) until you set real values.

competencies.name: Convert and use SI units
competencies.description: Fundamental and derived units, prefixes, conversions.

competencies.name: Distinguish scalars and vectors
competencies.description: Distance vs displacement, speed vs velocity.

competencies.name: Apply equations of uniform acceleration
competencies.description: v = u + at, s = ut + 1/2 at^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2as.

competencies.name: Apply Newton's laws of motion
competencies.description: F = ma, action and reaction, inertia.

competencies.name: Calculate work, energy and power
competencies.description: W = Fs, KE, PE, P = W/t.

competencies.name: Apply gas laws
competencies.description: Boyle's, Charles', pressure law, general gas equation.

competencies.name: Use wave quantities
competencies.description: v = f x wavelength, types of waves, superposition.

competencies.name: Apply reflection and refraction
competencies.description: Mirrors, lenses, Snell's law, ray diagrams.

competencies.name: Calculate electrical energy and power
competencies.description: P = IV, W = IVt, cost of energy.

competencies.name: Explain magnetic effects of current
competencies.description: Fields, force on conductors, electromagnetic induction.
